title: Lonar Crater: The Full Story of India's Lake Made by a Space Rock
description:
In June 2020, Lonar Lake in Maharashtra turned from green to pink. The bowl it sits in was punched into solid lava rock by a rock from space, and scientists still argue about when. Here's the full story, and how science worked it out.
